tools.name: setup_ibm_quantum_account_tool
tools.description: Set up IBM Quantum account with credentials. Call this before using other tools.

token.description: IBM Quantum API token. If empty, uses QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN env var or saved credentials from ~/.qiskit/qiskit-ibm.json

tools.name: ai_routing_tool
tools.description: Route a quantum circuit by inserting SWAP operations for backend compatibility. Use this FIRST before other synthesis tools.

circuit.description: Input quantum circuit as QASM 3.0 string or base64-encoded QPY

layout_mode.description: 'keep' (respect existing layout), 'improve' (refine initial guess), 'optimize' (best for general circuits)

optimization_preferences.description: What to minimize - 'n_cnots', 'n_gates', 'cnot_layers', 'layers', or 'noise'. Can be a list.

local_mode.description: True runs locally (recommended), False uses remote Qiskit Transpiler Service

coupling_map.description:
Optional list of qubit pairs representing the backend topology.
If provided, overrides the backend's coupling map. Useful for targeting a
specific subset of qubits.

circuit_format.description: Format of the input circuit - 'qasm3' (default) or 'qpy' (base64-encoded QPY for full circuit fidelity)

tools.name: hybrid_ai_transpile_tool
tools.description:
Transpile a circuit using a hybrid pass manager combining Qiskit heuristics with AI-powered passes.

This provides end-to-end transpilation that leverages both classical heuristic optimization
and AI-based optimization for routing and synthesis in a single unified pipeline.

circuit.description: Input quantum circuit as QASM 3.0 string or base64-encoded QPY

ai_optimization_level.description: Optimization level (1-3) for AI components. Higher = better results but slower.

ai_layout_mode.description:
Layout selection strategy:
- 'keep': Respect existing layout (for specific qubit requirements)
- 'improve': Use prior layout as starting point
- 'optimize': Best for general circuits (default)
Note: If initial_layout is provided with 'optimize', it automatically converts
to 'improve' to leverage the user-provided layout.

initial_layout.description:
Optional list of physical qubit indices specifying where to place
virtual qubits. For example, [0, 1, 5, 6, 7] maps virtual qubit 0 to physical
qubit 0, virtual qubit 1 to physical qubit 1, etc.

coupling_map.description:
Optional list of qubit pairs representing the backend topology.
If provided, overrides the backend's coupling map. Useful for targeting a
specific subset of qubits.

circuit_format.description: Format of the input circuit - 'qasm3' (default) or 'qpy' (base64-encoded QPY for full circuit fidelity)
